retainedLogEvidence.processIdentity: Emulator crash reporting identifies PID 7041, matching the shell SIGSEGV notification.
retainedLogEvidence.missingCrashEvidence: The emulator advertised /tmp/android-runner/emu-crash-37.2.13.db, but the artifact contains no crashpad database/core/minidump/backtrace. The path alone does not reveal the faulting component.

causalLimits.oom: No retained OOM/SIGKILL or kernel memory-pressure evidence establishes OOM. No host process/RSS census or kernel journal was retained. SIGSEGV alone must not be relabeled OOM.
causalLimits.application: The retained app log ends without an observed Android app fatal exception/signal. This does not exclude an application action triggering an emulator/graphics defect.
causalLimits.graphics: The observed emulator selected SwiftShader for GLES and Vulkan under gfxstream. A startup warning or renderer identity is not a crashing-component stack.
causalLimits.gradle: The build used --no-daemon and logged a single-use daemon that would stop at build completion; the build succeeded. There is no retained evidence proving a lingering Gradle/Kotlin daemon caused memory pressure.
causalLimits.explicitCleanup: The tested script defines emulator termination only in the EXIT cleanup. Original source line 102 runs the required flows; evidence pulls, decoders, verifier and phase status follow. The SIGSEGV notification precedes those evidence attempts and EXIT cleanup, so the explicit cleanup kill is not the observed prior termination.
causalLimits.exitCode: The raw emulator wait status was not retained. No numeric exit code is inferred from the signal text.
causalLimits.clockAlignment: Guest app timestamps, Maestro local timestamps and host workflow notification timestamps are not treated as an exactly synchronized crash clock.

relevantFacts: swiftshader_indirect is listed as deprecated starting Emulator 36.4.9.
The supported software selector chooses the most suitable software renderer for the AVD, features and quality.
officialDocumentation.inference: Changing only this mode removes an officially deprecated configuration without choosing a new hardware GPU or weakening the test.

relevantFacts: 36.4.9 Stable (2026-02-10) introduced -gpu software selection for software GLES/Vulkan backends and made Lavapipe the default software Vulkan renderer.
37.2.13 Patch (2026-10-28), already used by this run, documents a GLES resource-leak fix on application/process exit.
limits: These release notes do not identify this SIGSEGV.

recommendedNextStep.action: After the current iPhone job finishes and root publishes the reviewed candidate, one normal Android full-app follow-up is justified with existing evidence capture and all acceptance gates unchanged.
recommendedNextStep.whyNoExtraInstrumentationNow: The current authenticated shell and emulator logs already distinguish host SIGSEGV from transport loss and expose selected renderers. One supported-mode run can test stability while preserving a minimal configuration change; lack of a stack prevents a root-cause claim but does not block this bounded follow-up.
recommendedNextStep.successCriterion: The complete required navigation and memory-capture flows, media validation and final app verification pass; inspect the new emulator log rather than assuming software chose a different renderer.
recommendedNextStep.ifSigsegvRecurs: Retain the already-generated crashpad/minidump/core evidence and a bounded process/host result before selecting another corrective change. Reassess the concrete recurrence; do not preemptively increase memory, tier, timeouts, disable Vulkan or weaken assertions.
